services.name: Erie Canal Charters
services.desc: Combine Business & Pleasure For a memorable experience, treat your clients, customers or associates to an exclusive charter boat cruise. Our goal is to see that you and your guests have a wonderful time. Choose from our regular menus or let us arrange for special catering. Our fully stocked bar offers a wide variety of beverages. We can accommodate a DJ or live entertainment. Special morning cruises are available for school children and groups, with the option of a continental breakfast or brunch. blurb: Guests board the Colonial Belle in Fairport, NY for 2 to 3 hour Erie Canal cruises covering 14–16 miles. Cruises feature historic narration by the captain, food, and entertainment. Many themed cruises are offered from mid-May through October.
